headline: Kept the September 8, 2026 meeting record unchanged after a correction request.
summary: Staff discussed the Community Learning Center, including a new coordinator starting October 26 and an 11th allocation of $3,044,986 to cover overages. The board also talked about meeting room reservations and an art and object loan policy last approved in 2006. The director will get legal input on the loan policy before returning with any changes.

decision_titles: Timothy Shea request to correct September 8, 2026 meeting record
plain_text:
Town of South Kingstown   
Library Board of Trustees   
Regular Session Meeting Minutes 
Tuesday, October 13, 2026 at 6:00 PM   
Peace Dale Library 
Rhode Island Room 
1057 Kingstown Road, Peace Dale, RI 
www.southkingstownri.gov  
 
 
1. Call to Order & Roll Call: 
Approximately 6:01 
Board members present – Hilary Carlson, Mike Henry, Liz Kroll, Lindsey Madom, Timothy Murphy, and Bob Warren.  
Also present Laurel Clark, Library Director; Karyn Leahy , Deputy Director. 
Absent: Kim Salisbury-Keith 
Public present: Liz McNab 
2. Approval of Minutes: 
 A. Regular Meeting — September 8, 2026 
Correction from last meeting: The town is funding the CLC coordinator. All programming money goes to fund the CLC 
and meeting requirements, not staffing. 
Hillary moves to approve minutes. 
Tim seconds. 
All in favor. 
3. Correspondence 
 A. Timothy Shea Request for Correction of Public Record of Meeting Discussion on September 8, 2026 
Tim Murphy reads own letter into record (see attached) 
Tim Murphy moves to acknowledge receipt of Timothy Shea’s email, and to make no change to the public record. Hilary 
seconds. No discussion. All in favor. 
Director Clark notes we are all volunteers, and this is an open discussion 
4. Public Comment 
Liz McNab - Kingston library birthday 10/17. Speech at 1:30, so 1 to 4 is the time. December 5 – Kingston book sale – 
looking for donations. Bring to Kingston, if possible. But any library is fine. 
5. President's Report 
Nothing to report, except thank you to the Board. 
6. Director's Report 
Nonfiction is back on the shelves in Peace Dale. Thank you to staff. Bios are upstairs now. 
State aid application submitted. 
New pt library asst – Jack Gunter -- starting 10/20. Splitting time between Peace Dale and Kingston. 
Mike Henry recounted a recent NY Times article celebrating librarians, and his recent experience with two librarians at 
Kingston helping him with an audio book issue. 
7. Project and Grants Updates 
 A. Community Learning Center
o Hazard Garden 
o 11th Allocation — $3,044,986 
o Grant Close Out 
o Programming 
o CLC Coordinator Position 
 
o 11th Allocation — $3,044,986 
▪          Now over $3M to cover some overages with garden, parking lot, interior works. Includes all overages. 
 
o Grant Close Out 
 
o CLC Coordinator Position 
▪          New CLC Coordinator – Marloes Krabbe starting on 10/26, from Indiana. 
 
o Hazard Garden 
▪          Litter issue. Cans and empties. Reached out to SKPD. Keep an eye out. 
▪          A recent Brandi story walk through there was well received. 
 
o Programming 
▪          The first official CLC event – FAFSA workshop is tonight (Jeff Decker who does financial aid workshops). 
Yoga is starting Saturday, spots still open! 
▪          The RI food bank is coming for a nutrition label presentation 11/3 
▪          RI DLT coming = details to follow. 
▪          Laptops were received. There are plans to do a beginners' workshop in the near future. There have been 
requests for beginner computer classes – these computers will facilitate that through software normalization 
across devices. 12 total laptops. With 3 set aside for rooms, we will max out classes at 8 (with 1 for instructor). 
Will work with town IT to update software on laptops. 
▪          Waiting for a new CLC director before much more programming takes place. 
▪          Marloes (mar-LOOSE) Krabbe – Worked at a university and on a public water project. Has MLS, and some 
teaching experience in a library, and is looking to move into a more public-facing role. 
8. Meeting Room Usage Update and Policy 
Demand for rooms is rising. Currently only allow advance reservation once a month, though if a room is available, 
someone can take it. The library is still refining the reservation system and its granularity (e.g., raising the amount of 
uses a person can reserve in a period of time). 
Regarding room usage stats, the library staff expect to see a large increase month to month as awareness increases. 
All professional library staff are capable of assisting with reservations. 
9. Art/Object Loan and Exhibit Policy 
Happens very rarely. Policy last approved in 2006. Each building has its own unique collection. 
Discussed the policy and the complications of digital reproduction. 
Laurel Clark will get input from the solicitor’s office and then return with any changes and the loan request form for 
Board consideration. 
10. Statistics
Electronic usage stats. Hoopla is seeing a steady increased usage. Kanopy is increasing, too. 
Genealogy and Newsbank are also increasing. 
The state allows all in the state to get historical archive of Providence journal. An extensive collection of providence 
journals. 
11. Upcoming Programs 
October is one of the busiest program months in a long time, featuring the return of old favorites and introduction of 
some new programs. 
Kingston Free 250th Birthday Party! — October 17th 1:00 
Yoga for Beginners - Peace Dale — October 17th 10:00. Downstairs. Mats provided. 
The Greatest Sitcoms of All Time — October 20th 6:30 
Teen Mini Modeling Clay Creations — October 23rd 2:30 
Make-It Monday: Halloween - Peace Dale— October 26th 6:00 
Halloween Parade - Kingston Free Lawn - October 28th 10:30 
Literacy Volunteers of Washington County Office Hours — Peace Dale -Mondays 10-12 & Thursday 1-3. Will be 
onboarding new tutors or assisting folks looking to connect with tutors. Twice a week through mid-December. Then they 
will take a break and re-evaluate next year and modify as needed. 
Also, Peace Dale recently received a movie license and will be showing movies again. Probably starting in November, 
with more into the winter. 
 A. Kingston Free 250th Birthday Party! — October 17th 1:00 
Yoga for Beginners - Peace Dale — October 17th 10:00 
The Greatest Sitcoms of All Time — October 20th 6:30 
Teen Mini Modeling Clay Creations — October 23rd 2:30 
Make-It Monday: Halloween -  Peace Dale— October 26th 6:00 
Halloween Parade - Kingston Free Lawn - October 28th 10:30 
Literacy Volunteers of Washington County Office Hours — Peace Dale -Mondays 10-12 & Thursday 1-3  
12. Next Meeting: 
 A. November 9, 2026 
November 10, 2026 - (not 11/9 as printed on the agenda) 
13. Adjournment: 
Motion: Tim Murphy 
Second: Lindsay Madom 
All in favor. 
Meeting ended: 7:08pm
